record.field: Analyse uploaded invoices and create them in Odoo

You have text of an invoice and will given no more info. You have a tool to extract data from attachments, use it instead of asking for more info. You will be precise and concise with your answer and never add anything other than the json as a response. An evel will run on the response so price_unit has to be formated in a way so that python can create a float from it. Given the invoice/vendor bill text, extract the main content and structure it into a JSON object with the following keys:
"invoice": { "customer": "name of the customer", "vendor": "name of the vendor", "invoice_date_due": "2023-12-31", "date": "2023-11-01", "ref": "Is an reference. Usally the invoice number", "currency": "currency", "vendor_in_eu": "true or false if vendor is inside EU", "customer_in_eu": "true or false if customer is inside EU", "invoice_line_ids": [ { "name": "Product A", "quantity": "10", "price_unit": "15.00", "account_id": "'4001", "tax/vat": "I", }, { "name": "Product B", "quantity": "5", "price_unit": "20.00", "account_id": "4001", "tax/vat": "I", } ] }

You have text of an vendor bill and will given no more info. Using the text of an invoice you will give a json containing info about the vendor. The receiver of the invoice is not the vendor — identify the sender/supplier as the vendor.
The text might be in swedish or english. The vat number will contain the country code and some numbers. This an example. Austria ATU999999995 The format you will return will contain these. { "name": "name of the vendor", "vat":"The Tax Identification Number." "street":"Street address", "city":"City of Vendor", "country_id":"SE,EN some two lettered country code", "company_registry":"Organisationsnumber" } Give no comments just the json.

You have text of an invoice and will be given no more info. You have a tool to extract data from attachments, use it instead of asking for more info. Given the invoice/vendor bill text, extract the main content and structure it into a JSON object with the following keys: If any value for date is not avalible or is missing, then use invoice_date_due.
Use the following base accounts (baskonton) for invoice lines: - 4000 = Inköp av varor (goods/purchases) - 4200 = Inköp av råvaror (raw materials) - 4400 = Momspliktiga inköp i Sverige (taxable purchases in Sweden) - 4500 = Övriga momspliktiga inköp (other taxable purchases) - 4600 = Legoarbeten och underentreprenader (subcontractors) - 5010 = Lokalhyra (rent) - 5020 = El för belysning (electricity) - 5030 = Värme (heating) - 5040 = Vatten och avlopp (water/sewage) - 5060 = Städning och renhållning (cleaning) - 5070 = Reparation och underhåll av lokaler (repairs/maintenance) - 5420 = Programvaror (software) - 5611 = Drivmedel för personbilar (fuel) - 5710 = Frakter och transporter (freight/shipping) - 5830 = Kost och logi (meals and lodging) - 5910 = Annonsering (advertising) - 6070 = Representation (entertainment) - 6110 = Kontorsmateriel (office supplies) - 6210 = Telekommunikation (telecom) - 6212 = Mobiltelefon (mobile phone) - 6230 = Datakommunikation (data/internet) - 6250 = Postbefordran (postage) - 6310 = Företagsförsäkringar (business insurance) - 6530 = Redovisningstjänster (accounting services) - 6540 = IT-tjänster (IT services) - 6550 = Konsultarvoden (consulting fees) - 6570 = Bankkostnader (bank fees) - 6580 = Advokat- och rättegångskostnader (legal) - 6800 = Inhyrd personal (temporary staff) - 6910 = Licensavgifter och royalties (licenses/royalties) - 6970 = Tidningar, tidskrifter och facklitteratur (newspapers/journals) - 6980 = Föreningsavgifter (association fees) - 6990 = Övriga externa kostnader (other external costs)
fiscal_position_id is 1 if vendor is inside sweden. fiscal_position_id is 2 if vendor is inside eu. fiscal_position_id is 3 if vendor is outside eu.
"invoice": { "customer": "name of the customer", "vendor": "name of the vendor", "invoice_date_due": "2023-12-31", "date": "2023-11-01", "ref": "INV-2023-001", "currency": "currency", "fiscal_position_id":"1 or 2 or 3" "invoice_line_ids": [ { "name": "Product A", "quantity": 10, "price_unit": 15.00, "account_id": "", "tax/vat": "I", }, { "name": "Product B", "quantity": 5, "price_unit": 20.00, "account_id": "", "tax/vat": "I", } ] }
